description: Webhook ingestion with HMAC signature verification, provider routing, and idempotent retry queue.

dataModels: WebhookEvent { id, provider, type, payload, receivedAt }
QueuedEvent { id, payload, state, attempts, lastError }
architectureNotes: architecture: webhook-handler.ts → verifySignature(provider, payload, signature, secret) with timing-safe HMAC comparison
architecture: webhook-router.ts → createWebhookRouter({ providers }) returns async (req) => response, matches provider by signature header presence
architecture: webhook-queue.ts → createWebhookQueue() for idempotent dedup + retry with exponential backoff
productionNotes: webhook-queue uses in-memory Map — replace with Redis/BullMQ for durable processing
productionNotes: Add persistent event log (Postgres/DynamoDB) for audit trail
productionNotes: webhook-config.json secrets should come from environment variables, not the config file
